evals.prompt: Export all my notes on arXiv 2401.12345 to ~/ObsidianVault/prioris-notes.
evals.expected_output: Searches for every note matching the given paper (project-scoped), confirms the destination path, then for each note reads the export resource and writes it via render_note_export.py, reporting how many files were written.
expectations: Searches for notes scoped to the given paper via research_notes_search before exporting
Reads notes://{note_id}/export for each selected note rather than reconstructing frontmatter itself
Pipes each export result into render_note_export.py rather than hand-writing YAML
Reports the count and destination of files written at the end

evals.prompt: Export my notes to a vault.
evals.expected_output: Asks for the destination vault path first, since nothing else can proceed without it, before asking which notes to export.
expectations: Does not attempt to export anything before a destination path is established
Asks for the vault path explicitly
Only after the path is known does it ask which notes (or confirm 'all', project-scoped) to export

evals.prompt: Export note abc-123-def to ~/vault, even though I already exported it there last week.
evals.expected_output: Overwrites the existing file at the destination without treating that as an error, and tells the user it was overwritten.
expectations: Does not refuse or error because a file already exists at the destination
Explicitly mentions that the existing file was overwritten with the current note content
Does not attempt to merge the new export with the existing file's content
